item.title: Pancreatic Cancer Radar — week of 2026-10-17
item.description:
1. Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma, Version 4.2026, NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines In Oncology. — The NCCN Guidelines for Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma outline multidisciplinary diagnostic workup, staging, and treatment recommendations across resectable, borderline resectable, locally advanced, and metastatic disease stages.
  2. Strategies to develop therapeutic cancer vaccines for pancreatic cancer. — A review of 120 clinical trials shows pancreatic cancer vaccines induce immune responses but rarely translate into durable clinical benefit without multimodal combination strategies.
  3. Prognostic and Clinicopathological Significance of CD74 Expression in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. — A meta-analysis found that elevated CD74 expression in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is significantly associated with increased tumor invasion, lymph node metastasis, and worse overall survival.
  4. Efficacy and Safety of Daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) in Previously Treated Metastatic RAS-Mutated Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: A Systematic Review. — A systematic review demonstrates that daraxonrasib significantly improves survival and response rates over chemotherapy with manageable toxicity in previously treated RAS G12-mutated metastatic pancreatic cancer.
  5. Radiotherapy combined with serplulimab, and chemotherapy as first-line treatment for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma: a multicenter, single-arm, phase II trial. — First-line serplulimab combined with chemotherapy and radiotherapy achieved a 78.3% 6-month progression-free survival rate and promising overall survival in metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
